نرتق (form VIII)
# نَرْتَقِ (nartaqi) /nar.ta.qi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# نُرْتَقَ (nurtaqa) /nur.ta.qa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
